item.title: Ayatollah's son Mojtaba Khamenei elected as Iran's next Supreme Leader: Report
Was the US attack on Iran predicted just days before? Ex-CIA officer John Kiriakou's shocking warning
item.description: Following Operation Epic Fury, the United States and Israel launched sweeping strikes on Iran’s missile and nuclear infrastructure, an assault that killed Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, and triggered widespread regional retaliation. The escalation came just days after former CIA officer John Kiriakou publicly warned that Washington had already decided to attack, a claim that now appears to have foreshadowed one of the most consequential confrontations in years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘I’m not happy with the UK’: Donald Trump criticizes Keir Starmer over military access
item.description: President Trump has sharply criticized UK Prime Minister Starmer for initially withholding UK bases for US strikes on Iran, stating the "special relationship" has weakened. Starmer later agreed to limited defensive use of two bases after a UK base in Cyprus was attacked. The UK emphasizes acting on a legal basis and in its national interest, recalling Iraq war lessons.

item.title: Kash Patel fires FBI agents with Iran expertise days before Tehran strike, also ousts members who investigated Trump: Report
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel reportedly fired a dozen agents from an elite counter-espionage unit, CI-12, which specializes in threats from Iran. These firings occurred amid an investigation into Donald Trump's handling of classified documents and shortly before Trump launched bombing strikes on Iran.

item.title: Texas bar shooting: Suspect Ndiaga Diagne previously posted misogynistic, antisemitic and racist remarks, praised Islamic revolution — report claims
item.description: A deadly shootout erupted at Buford's Backyard Beer Garden after a man, identified as Ndiaga Diagne, opened fire. Authorities are investigating the incident, potentially linked to recent US and Israeli actions in Iran. Diagne's online activity revealed a history of hateful rhetoric, including antisemitic and anti-Christian sentiments, raising concerns about his motives.

item.title: 'Everything knocked out': Trump on Iran strikes, says he 'might have forced Israel's hand'
item.description: US President Donald Trump asserted that Iran's military capabilities have been significantly degraded, with "everything knocked out" following a joint operation with Israel that resulted in the death of Supreme Leader Khamenei. He suggested this action preempted an imminent Iranian attack, stating, "I might have forced Israel's hand. He further called the Iran regime "evil"
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Kristi Noem under fire for $300 million DHS jet spending amid border funding fight
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem faces criticism for allegedly spending over $300 million on three private luxury jets, diverting funds intended for border security. The purchase, including a Boeing 737 Max 8, has drawn sharp condemnation from Democrats and watchdog groups, who question the necessity and legality of the expenditure amid budget constraints.

item.title: After 'solving' eight wars, Trump gives ten interviews to explain initiating ninth: I got Khamenei before he got me
item.description: President Trump offered multiple justifications for the air campaign against Iran, including a preemptive strike against its supreme leader. He cited intelligence of assassination plots, election interference, and an imminent nuclear threat, though evidence remains unrevealed. Trump's strategy aims to control the narrative, presenting varied reasons to different outlets.

item.title: Irony much? This Jewish British billionaire wants to move to Germany over UK's ‘anti-Jew’ stance
item.description: A prominent Jewish billionaire, Sir Michael Moritz, born in Britain, is seeking German citizenship. He feels Britain has become an uncomfortable place for Jews today. Moritz believes Germany's civic identity is built on confronting its past. This move highlights growing concerns within Britain's Jewish community about social cohesion and belonging.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Israel is the boss’: Ex-MAGA ally Nick Fuentes slams Trump over Iran strike, urges supporters to abandon Republicans
item.description: Far-right commentator Nick Fuentes is calling on his supporters to reject President Donald Trump. Fuentes claims Trump made statements about soldiers dying and asserts that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu holds significant power over American decisions. He alleges that Jewish people control America's financial and political leverage.

item.title: Watch: CNN Turk crew detained live on air in Tel Aviv after Iranian missile strike
item.description: A CNN Turk reporting team was detained by Israeli security forces during a live broadcast from Tel Aviv following an Iranian missile strike. Correspondent Emrah Çakmak and cameraman Halil Kahraman were taken into custody outside the Ministry of Defense, with the live feed abruptly cut. Türkiye has launched diplomatic efforts, calling the incident an "attack on the press."
